question: What transition is made from the three-storey form to the four-storey teaching?
premises: The three-storey form has been described.
The four-storey form is introduced next.
The text states it is now being explained.
inference: Having described the three-storey form, the text now proceeds to state the four-storey form.
uncertainties: The compounds hyevamākhyātaṃ and mathocyate contain internal sandhi.
plain_english: The three-storey form has thus been described; now the four-storey form is stated.
